fnol_text: My name is Lucia Fitzgerald and I live at 561 Thornbury Road, Clinton, NC 28391. You can reach me on (555) 980-2956 or lucia.fitzgerald@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 14 February 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00002. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Fitzgerald on (555) 980-2956 to acknowledge the claim. Lucia confirmed the loss date as 14 February 2024.
Site visit to 561 Thornbury Road. Neighbour Mateo Herrera was present and confirmed the timeline.
Lucia sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
